# Standard GeoTIFF fixture

Generated by Rasterio 1.5.2 / GDAL 3.12.2 using `fixture()` from
`tests/preprocessing/elevation.test.py` and `scripts/prepare-elevation.py`.
Synthetic eleven-point scene; no real/user data. Ground cell mean=11, DSM=20,
no-ground roof cell DSM=25, insufficient-ground cell DSM=7, empty cells NoData.
The TS fixture copies source assets and rebinds manifest source metadata to their
new runtime filesystem revision; raster bytes/hashes remain unchanged. GeoTIFF
embedded source tags are descriptive; the checked manifest is the binding.
